rationale: The agent did not complete the user request properly. While the conversation began with an authentication step, the agent failed to confirm each change before acting. The request to change the address to 101 Highway was executed, but when it came to reverting the address back, the agent opted to transfer the user to a human agent without confirming the change back. The policy dictates that confirmation for any changes must take place before acting, which was not adhered to here. This creates a failure in following the established protocol.
